text:
Which statements about the products of electrolysis, using inert electrodes, are correct?
When molten lead(II) bromide is electrolysed, bromine is formed at the cathode.
1
2
When dilute sulfuric acid is electrolysed, oxygen is formed at the anode.
3
When concentrated aqueous sodium chloride is electrolysed, sodium is formed at
the cathode.
4
When concentrated hydrochloric acid is electrolysed, chlorine is formed at the
anode.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 and 4
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
